minors.issue: TestAgentPushLoadsIntoProxy takes its expected document from GET /config/ after Push, not from the document Push posted, so it never proves that real Caddy's /config/ answer deep-equals the pushed body. That equality is what keeps Proxy.Run from pushing again on every probe.
minors.scenario: If the guard or Caddy ever answered GET /config/ with a document that differs from the posted one (an added or normalised field), differs() would return true every second and Run would push every second forever. The test would still pass, because want and the restored config come from the same GET.
